name: Converter
description: Currency and unit conversion in a flyout, with the live rate of a favourite pair on the tile — ECB rates via Frankfurter, no API key

baseCurrency.description: ISO code the ECB table is fetched against (EUR, USD, GBP, …); every pair converts through that one table

favoritePair.description: Pair shown on the bar tile as FROM/TO, e.g. EUR/USD

decimals.description: Decimal places of conversion results (0-10); tiny values keep three significant digits

refreshHours.description: Hours between rate downloads (1-168); the ECB publishes once per working day
